Retail Sales & Merchandising Analytics Platform

Welcome to Vecta Retail Analytics

Your unified analytics platform for Retail Sales, Retail Merchandising, Category Management, and B2C eCommerce. Top KPIs like Sales, Gross Margins, and Foot Traffic are driven by Store Performance, Category Management, and Marketing insights.

Explore the Liveboard or ask SalesBeacon to uncover opportunities to grow Sales and Gross Profits by increasing transaction volume, average ticket size, and average basket size.

📊 Exec KPIs Sales, Gross Profit & Margin, # of Transactions, Avg Transaction Size, Avg Basket Size — for Sales, Store Ops, Merchandising & Marketing leaders.
🏪 Store Performance Insights by store and store format — for Merchandising Leaders, Sales Managers, and Store Managers.
🛒 Category Management Sales, margins & trends by category, department, brand, and product — for Category & Brand Managers.
👥 Customer Analysis Insights by customer segments and profiles — for Marketing and Brand Managers.
